entries.name: Ailyssa's island errand
entries.text: Ailyssa asks the new party to find Sally beyond the village, on the open-ocean shore north of town, then bring a Potion Bottle back to her. Follow the road out of town past the Shops, Guilds, and Lord Markham signs; those signs mark the village, while Sally waits farther out by the sea. Face the person until the reticle names Sally, then return to town, buy a Potion Bottle from Tor at The Knight's Blade, and bring it back to Ailyssa.

objectives.label: Speak with Sally by the shore
Bring a Potion Bottle back to Ailyssa
